meta.title: GovVoice Rwanda — Sisitemu y’Ibibazo n’Ibitekerezo by’Abaturage
meta.description: Ohereza ibibazo, ibyifuzo n’ibishimira ku biro by’ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda. Kurikirana ibisubizo mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza cyangwa Igifaransa.

home.hero_eyebrow: Ijwi ry’umuturage w’u Rwanda, rihujwe n’ubutegetsi
home.hero_title: Ijwi ryawe. Umuryango wawe. U Rwanda ruza imbere.
home.hero_subtitle: Ohereza ibibazo, ibyifuzo n’ibishimira mu biro by’ubutegetsi bishinzwe. Kurikirana buri ntambwe, ubone ibisubizo nyakuri, kandi ufashe kubaka U Rwanda rukorera abaturage bose.
home.hero_note: Birizewe. Mu ndimi eshatu. Bihari ku muturage wese.
home.hero_card_subtitle: Kurikirana uko ikibazo cyawe kigenda kugeza gikemutse.
home.hero_card_update: Ikibazo cyawe cyahawe itsinda rishinzwe ibikorwa remezo.
home.why_subtitle: Ahantu hamwe hizewe ho kuvuga, gukurikirana no kubona impinduka mu muryango wawe.
home.why_1_desc: Igitekerezo cyawe kijyanwa ku karere n’ishami bishinzwe ikibazo.
home.why_2_desc: Kurikirana ikibazo cyawe mu gihe nyacyo, ukabona amateka y’imiterere n’igihe igisubizo giteganyijwe.
home.why_3_desc: Sangiza ku ruhande rw’abaturage kugira ngo utere impinduka, cyangwa ugume mu ibanga hagati yawe n’ubutegetsi bubishinzwe.
home.why_4_desc: Ubutumwa bwo kwibutsa n’ubwo kuzamura ikibazo bikomeza buri kibazo kugeza gikemutse.
home.how_title: Kuva ku ijwi kugeza ku gisubizo mu ntambwe enye
home.how_subtitle: Inzira yoroshye, ishinzwe kubazwa, ikorera mu rurimi wifuza.
home.step_1_desc: Kwiyandikisha ukoresheje indangamuntu, uhitemo intara, akarere n’umurenge.
home.step_2_desc: Hitamo ikibazo, igitekerezo cyangwa ikishimira. Ongeraho amakuru, amafoto cyangwa PDF.
home.step_3_desc: Kurikirana aho ikibazo kigeze kandi uvugane n’ubutegetsi bubishinzwe uhereye ku mbonerahamwe yawe.
home.step_4_desc: Tubwire niba ikibazo cyakemutse koko. Niba kitarakemuka, ushobora kongera kugifungura.
home.testimonials_subtitle: Impinduka nyayo zitangira iyo abaturage bumvwa.
home.testimonial_1_quote: Natanze ikirego ku muyoboro w’amazi wari wapfuye hafi y’umurenge. Akarere kasubije bukeye, kandi itsinda ryo gutunganya ryaje uko kuri kwa cyumweru.
home.testimonial_2_quote: Ikintu cyiza ni ukubona buri nkuru nshya. Nari nzi neza uwo wari ushinzwe ikibazo cyanjye n’igihe igisubizo cyari kuzaza.
home.testimonial_3_quote: Igitekerezo cyacu ku matara y’umuhanda cyasohotse ku rubuga rusange. Nyuma y’ibyumweru bitandatu, amatara yashyizweho.
home.faq_subtitle: Ibyo ugomba kumenya mbere yo gutanga ijwi ryawe.
home.faq_a1: Ushobora kohereza ikirego ku serivisi rusange, igitekerezo cyo guteza imbere umuryango wawe, cyangwa ikishimira ku serivisi cyangwa umukozi wagize uruhare rwiza.
home.faq_a2: Uhita ubona nimero yo gukurikirana nyuma yo kohereza. Yikoreshe ku rupapuro rwo gukurikirana, cyangwa winjire urebe ibitekerezo byawe byose n’imiterere yabyo ku mbonerahamwe yawe.
home.faq_q3: Ni bande bashobora kubona igitekerezo cyanjye?
home.faq_a3: Nuhitamo Ahabona, igitekerezo cyawe kigaragara ku rubuga rusange nta makuru yawe bwite. Nuhitamo Ibanga, aboneka gusa wowe n’abayobozi ba leta babishinzwe.
home.faq_a4: Ushobora kongera gufungura ikibazo cyakemutse cyangwa cyafunzwe mu minsi 30, uvuge impamvu. Biro ishinzwe iramenyeshwa kandi igomba gusubiza ukundi.
home.faq_q5: GovVoice ni ubuntu? Ni izihe ndimi zihari?
home.faq_a5: Yego, urubuga ni ubuntu ku baturage bose. Urubuga n’ubutumwa bwa SMS biraboneka mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza n’Igifaransa.
home.cta_final_subtitle: Bifata iminota itarenze itanu gutanga igitekerezo gishobora guteza imbere serivisi rusange mu muryango wawe wose.

auth.login_subtitle: Injira kugira ngo ukurikire ibitekerezo byawe kandi ubone amakuru mashya.
auth.register_subtitle: Iyandikishe kuri GovVoice utange igitekerezo kandi ukurikire ibisubizo by’ubutegetsi.
auth.national_id_hint: Andika imibare 16 iri kuri indangamuntu yawe.
auth.forgot: Wibagiwe ijambobanga? Vugana n’ubufasha bwo hafi yawe.
auth.terms_note: Ukomeje, wemera Amabwiriza yo Gukoresha n’Politiki y’Ibanga.
auth.consent: Nemeza ko amakuru ntanga ari ay’ukuri kandi nemera amabwiriza yo gukoresha.
auth.register_success: Konti yawe yiteguye. Murakaza neza kuri GovVoice.
auth.password_hint: Koresha nibura inyuguti 8 zirimo inyuguti nkuru, nto, umubare n’ikimenyetso kidasanzwe.
auth.secure_note: Amakuru yawe arinzwe kandi ntabwo agurishwa.
auth.have_voice_body: Iyunge n’abaturage benshi bagira uruhare mu guteza imbere serivisi rusange mu Rwanda.
auth.testimonial: “Natanze ikibazo ku wa mbere, mbona igisubizo cy’ubutegetsi ku wa gatatu. Ubwo ni ubwishingizi nshobora kubona.”

modal.terms_body: GovVoice Rwanda itangwa ku bitekerezo by’abaturage by’ukuri. Ntutange amakuru y’ibinyoma, ibigayitse cyangwa amakuru bwite y’undi muntu. Ibitekerezo bishobora kuganirwaho n’inzego za leta zibishinzwe. Gukoresha nabi bishobora kuhagarika konti.
modal.privacy_body: Dukusanya indangamuntu, amakuru y’itumanaho n’aho utuye kugira ngo twemeze umwirondoro wawe, twohereze igitekerezo cyawe aho gikwiye kandi tugume tuguhuza n’amakuru. Amakuru yawe bwite ntabwo agaragazwa ku rubuga rusange. Amakuru abikwa mu mutekano kandi abonwa gusa n’abayobozi bemewe n’abacunga urubuga.
